Provenance for coinbase-textfirst-977534.hex

A stratum job captured from a daemon running the text-first coinbase layout (BCH mainnet
template, height 977534), assembled as coinb1 | en1 | en2 | coinb2 with a zeroed extranonce2.
It is a job, not an on-chain transaction: no block was solved with it.

scriptSig (length 0x3d = 61 bytes):
  height   03 7eea0e                    (977534, little-endian)
  text     33 raw bytes, no push length "/BlockSniper.ai/ AI Shared Mining"
  flags    00
  time     04 fd2dfa6a
  nsec     04 296ea40b
  en push  0c                           (en1 + en2 = 4 + 8 = 12 bytes)

coinb1   = version | 1 input | null prevout | scriptSig length | scriptSig up to and including
           the 0c extranonce push length (ends ...0004fd2dfa6a04296ea40b0c)
en1      = 792dfa6a            (4 bytes)
en2      = 0000000000000000    (8 bytes, en2 size 8, zeroed)
coinb2   = ffffffff (input sequence) | 02 | two P2PKH outputs paying the same script
           (values 0x1244af2a and 0x005f714a satoshis) | locktime 00000000
         starts at ffffffff; the pool text sits in coinb1, so coinb2 carries no btcsig push.
